title: The Necrolith and the World Tree
prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: a colossal dead World Tree, cracked and grey, in a lifeless wasteland at the end of time. Tiny Gideon hovers at its vast trunk pressing a ring to the bark; sickly green light spreads through the wood like glowing veins and the first green shoots appear. Hopeful and eerie. Characters: Gideon: a slight fairy necromancer with large translucent insect wings, pointed ears and dark ragged clothing, faint green necrotic light around his hands.

references.role: Character appearance reference for Gideon. Preserve the face, hair, build, colours and outfit shown; ignore the background, base and any interface elements.
